preconditions.description: The number of test cases T must be between 1 and 10.
The number of officers N must be between 1 and 100,000.
Chef's initial coordinate C must be between 1 and 1,000,000,000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= P[i] <= 10**9 for i in range(N))
preconditions.description: Each officer's initial coordinate P_i must be between 1 and 1,000,000,000.
All coordinates must be unique, including Chef's coordinate C.

postconditions.description: The output must contain two space-separated integers: the maximum number of officers eliminated and whether Chef runs away or is caught.
The maximum number of officers eliminated must be a non-negative integer not exceeding the total number of officers.
The result must indicate whether Chef runs away (1) or is caught (-1).

postconditions.expression: max_eliminated == N if result == 1 else max_eliminated < N
postconditions.description: If Chef runs away, all officers must be eliminated; otherwise, fewer than all officers must be eliminated.

raw_response: {"interface":{"mode":"stdin_stdout","signature":"stdin -> stdout"},"preconditions":[{"id":"P1","expression":"1 <= T <= 10","description":"The number of test cases T must be between 1 and 10."},{"id":"P2","expression":"1 <= N <= 10**5","description":"The number of officers N must be between 1 and 100,000."},{"id":"P3","expression":"1 <= C <= 10**9","description":"Chef's initial coordinate C must be between 1 and 1,000,000,000."},{"id":"P4","expression":"all(1 <= P[i] <= 10**9 for i in range(N))","description":"Each officer's initial coordinate P_i must be between 1 and 1,000,000,000."},{"id":"P5","expression":"len(set(P + [C])) == N + 1","description":"All coordinates must be unique, including Chef's coordinate C."}],"postconditions":[{"id":"Q1","expression":"stdout == f'{max_eliminated} {result}'","description":"The output must contain two space-separated integers: the maximum number of officers eliminated and whether Chef runs away or is caught."},{"id":"Q2","expression":"max_eliminated >= 0 and max_eliminated <= N","description":"The maximum number of officers eliminated must be a non-negative integer not exceeding the total number of officers."},{"id":"Q3","expression":"result in {-1, 1}","description":"The result must indicate whether Chef runs away (1) or is caught (-1)."},{"id":"Q4","expression":"max_eliminated == N if result == 1 else max_eliminated < N","description":"If Chef runs away, all officers must be eliminated; otherwise, fewer than all officers must be eliminated."}],"invariants":[]}
